title: Fix deterministic recall correctness matcher
notes: Evaluates structured MESA results first before text matching.
Detects negation (e.g. 'does not use FastAPI') and ambiguity ('unclear whether...'), failing closed / returning NEEDS_REVIEW instead of naive false-positive PASS.
Handles contrastive clauses appropriately (e.g. 'does not use Django, but uses FastAPI' positively confirms FastAPI).
